speaker: Narrator
text: Behind his stall, the peddler Hask winks at his apprentice as he inks a fake vault map, copying the coastline wrong on purpose.

speaker: Pell
text: Pell pays Hask ten silver for the map and rolls it up carefully.

speaker: Pell
text: "This is the true map to the drowned vault," Pell says, hugging it to his chest. "My fortune is made."

speaker: Hask
text: "The truest map in the city," Hask says, smiling at his coins.
